sloka: ततो नालीक नाराचैः तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः विकर्णिभिः ।भीमम् आर्त स्वरम् चक्रुः छिद्यमाना निशाचराः ॥३-२५-२५॥
transliteration: tato nālīka nārācaiḥ tīkṣṇa agraiḥ vikarṇibhiḥ ।bhīmam ārta svaram cakruḥ chidyamānā niśācarāḥ ॥3-25-25॥

translations.english: Just like the dried up forest burnt by the fire, the army was totally destroyed by Rama's arrows that pierced into the vital parts of the soldiers.
